audit_item: M0.2 / worker request field-validation diagnostics and Hosted CI follow-up
finding: Hosted run 39834856764 failed the Windows and Linux CPU world-model jobs on test_worker_rejects_invalid_anchor_or_instrument_before_forward[anchor_close-nan-anchor close]. The strict JSON parser rejected NaN before the request validator could report the invalid anchor_close field, yielding a generic parser detail instead of the field-specific diagnostic asserted by the contract test.
change: Keep duplicate-key rejection and strict rejection of non-standard JSON constants by default. The worker request boundary now retries only the non-standard-constant parse case with constants represented as floats, rejects all non-finite request values recursively, and lets the existing anchor_close validation produce its precise finite-positive error. Other request fields remain explicitly rejected when non-finite.
